news.title: Suspect caught after officer dragged hundreds of yards during traffic stop
news.summary: An officer is being treated Grady Memorial Hospital after being dragged during a traffic stop Friday, Covington police said.

news.title: Metro Atlanta elementary school locked down over suspect chase
news.summary: Police activity near an elementary school prompted a brief lockdown Friday, a school district spokesperson confirmed.

news.title: Covington officer taken to hospital after being dragged by vehicle
news.summary: An officer was taken to the hospital after being dragged by a vehicle in Covington on Friday afternoon, according to police.

news.title: 2 facing human trafficking indictment after prostitution sting in Conyers
news.summary: During the operation, the officers encountered a juvenile who was connected to an online commercial sex advertisement.

news.title: Cherokee County deputies seek truck owner in burglary case
news.summary: Cherokee County authorities are asking for the public's help to identify the owner of a pickup truck possibly linked to a burglary investigation in the Waleska area.

news.title: Son charged with father’s murder at DeKalb County home near elementary school
news.summary: Police said a man has been arrested in connection with the shooting death of his 65-year-old father at a home Friday.

news.title: 2 indicted after Conyers hotel sex trafficking sting
news.summary: A man and a woman were indicted on sex trafficking charges stemming from a Conyers hotel sting, according to police.

news.title: Gwinnett County mom charged in son's hot car death in can attend funeral
news.summary: A judge will allow Deja Coleman, the Gwinnett County mother charged with second-degree murder in her 1-year-old son's hot car death, to attend his funeral Saturday.

news.title: Smyrna Police identify suspect seen in pistol-whipping road rage incident caught on video
news.summary: Police say a man was "pummeled with a handgun" in a fight on June 27. A suspect has now been identified.

news.title: Son arrested for killing 65-year-old father in DeKalb County
news.summary: DeKalb County police have identified the man found dead outside a home Friday morning as 65-year-old Jerome Wyatt.
